newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index falls 1.97 pct on Telkom.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index falls 1.97 pct on Telkom.

text.p: The Jakarta composite index fell 1.97 percent on heavy foreign selling of Telkom shares in late trading on Tuesday on speculation that a competitor might emerge, brokers said on Tuesday.
"It's basically because of Telkom," one broker said. "The selling is being done mostly by foreign investors on speculation that a competitor to Telkom is taking shape."
Telkom fell 200 rupiah to 3,625 rupiah on a volume of more than 36 million shares, making it the most actively traded counter so far on Tuesday.
Telkom carries the heaviest weight of around 18 percent on the Jakarta index.
The brokers said market talk that Telkom's possible competitor might use conglomerate PT Bimantara Citra as a vehicle saw Bimantara prices making handsome gains.
Bimantara rose 125 rupiah to 3,250 rupiah on a volume of close to 1.6 million shares.
"Talk is that Bimantara might be the vehicle for the Telkom competitor," one broker said.
